sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B Review: Benchmarks & Performance
sources.snippet: MiniCPM5-2B is a serious small language model for local AI, coding assistance, reasoning, tool use and lightweight agent workflows. Its biggest strengths are capability per parameter, a native 131K context window, multiple local deployment formats and strong results on OpenBMB’s code, math and tool-use evaluations.
